title: Inside a secretive Ukrainian team launching deep drone strikes at Russia
summary: Ukraine's long-range drones are striking deep inside Russia, up to 1,200 miles away, hitting oil refineries and depots. NPR recently spent time with one of the Ukrainian strike teams launching drones at Russian targets.
contentText:
